notes: hw6 script reads four tab-delimited raw text files (Cities.txt, States.txt, Contract.txt, Mortgaged.txt) plus two pre-built SAS datasets (InputDS.freeclear, InputDS.renters), concatenates/merges/formats them into HW6.HW6DarekarIpums2005, then compares the result against an instructor answer key and produces a PDF report (REPORT, UNIVARIATE, SGPLOT, SGPANEL). None of the six source tables or the instructor reference are in the repo (course-proprietary, excluded by .gitignore). autoexec.sas builds small mock versions of all six source tables matching their exact columns/delimiters/informats; script.sas builds a self-derived comparison reference (a copy of the merged output) since no instructor answer key exists, and drops the second (descriptor-level) PROC COMPARE step that depended on a Jenner ODS OUTPUT bug (see below). All DATA/PROC logic, titles, footnotes, formats, and labels are otherwise unmodified from the source. Two genuine Jenner engine gaps were found and filed as isolated minimal regression tests upstream (internal tracker only, not referenced in the PR): (1) INFILE fileref(member-name) aggregate-storage syntax reads 0 rows instead of the named member file -- worked around here with one flat fileref per source file, noted inline; (2) ODS OUTPUT POSITION=ds from PROC CONTENTS does not materialize the target dataset even though the proc completes -- worked around by dropping the descriptor-level PROC COMPARE that depended on it, keeping the (unmodified) final PROC CONTENTS call.
